title: ever IVORY|Open Lantern Sleeve A-Line Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant A-line mother of the bride dress features open lantern sleeves that add a touch of drama and sophistication. The flowing silhouette enhances your figure while ensuring comfort throughout the day. Perfect for a timeless, graceful look, this dress is designed to make you feel confident and beautiful.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
